problem:
The seats in a certain theater are labeled with an ordered combination of $3$ possible characters, as shown below:

| Letter | Letter | Digit |
| --- | --- | --- |

Here,

- the first "Letter" can be any of the following: N, S, E, W.

- the second "Letter" can be any capital from A-J ($10$ in total), and

- each "Digit" can be any integer between $0$-$9.$

How many possible ordered combinations are there?
